cases.purpose: Exercise read-write and read-only bind mounts and remount-readonly in a private mapped-user mount namespace.
cases.oracle: Native mount controls and independent file effects, errno and findmnt observations.
cases.comparison: Retain command statuses, EROFS results and mountinfo; setup failure is incomplete. Native and candidate findmnt OPTIONS are recorded for each fixture mount and compared as option sets.

files.inner.sh:
[[ $UID == "$EUID" && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r marker </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
/usr/bin/python3 /opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/ns_guest_identity_r1.py || exit 125
IFS= read -r vendor </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
[[ $vendor == QEMU && $marker =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
if ((EUID==0)); then
  mapfile -t maps </proc/self/uid_map || exit 125
  (( ${#maps[@]} == 1 )) || exit 125
  read -r a b n tail <<<"${maps[0]}"; [[ $a == 0 && $b == 2000 && $n == 1 && -z $tail ]] || exit 125
else ((EUID==2000)) || exit 125; fi
virt=$(/usr/bin/systemd-detect-virt --vm) || exit 125
[[ $virt == qemu || $virt == kvm ]] || exit 125
inside=$(/usr/bin/readlink "/proc/$BASHPID/ns/mnt") || exit 98
[[ $EUID == 0 && -n $FIXTURE_OUTER_MNT && $inside != "$FIXTURE_OUTER_MNT" && $(type -t ns) == builtin ]] || exit 125
base=/tmp/parity-case/candidate-mount/tmp
/usr/bin/mkdir -p "$base" || exit 98
/usr/bin/mount --make-rprivate / || exit 98
/usr/bin/mount -t tmpfs -o size=1m tmpfs "$base" || exit 98
/usr/bin/mkdir "$base/src" "$base/rw" "$base/ro" "$base/fs" || exit 98
printf 'before\n' >"$base/src/data"
/usr/bin/mount -t tmpfs -o size=1m tmpfs "$base/fs" || exit 98
ns bind "$base/src" "$base/rw" >"$HOME/rw.out" 2>"$HOME/rw.err"; a=$?
ns bind "$base/src" "$base/ro" ro >"$HOME/ro.out" 2>"$HOME/ro.err"; b=$?
ns remount-readonly "$base/fs" >"$HOME/fs.out" 2>"$HOME/fs.err"; c=$?
printf 'rw=%s ro=%s remount=%s\n' "$a" "$b" "$c" | /usr/bin/tee "$HOME/mount-status.raw"
/usr/bin/python3 check.py
files.check.py:
import errno, json, os, pathlib, subprocess, uuid
H=pathlib.Path('/tmp/parity-home'); C=pathlib.Path('/tmp/parity-case')
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers')
from ns_guest_identity_r1 import verify
verify()
rows=[list(map(int,row.split())) for row in pathlib.Path('/proc/self/uid_map').read_text().splitlines()]
if (pathlib.Path('/sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor').read_text().strip()!='QEMU' or
    pathlib.Path.cwd()!=C or os.environ.get('HOME')!=str(H) or os.getuid()!=0 or os.geteuid()!=0 or
    rows!=[[0,2000,1]] or not os.environ.get('FIXTURE_OUTER_MNT') or
    os.readlink('/proc/self/ns/mnt')==os.environ['FIXTURE_OUTER_MNT']):
 raise RuntimeError('not private mapped guest mount context')
p=C/'candidate-mount/tmp'
native=json.loads((H/'mount-control.json').read_text())
for name in ('rw','ro','fs'):
 control=native['findmnt'][name]
 if control['status']!=0 or not control.get('options'):
  raise RuntimeError('native findmnt control incomplete: '+name)
r={}
try:
 (p/'rw'/'data').write_text('via-rw\n'); r['rw_source']=(p/'src'/'data').read_text()
except OSError as e: r['rw_errno']=e.errno
for name in ('ro','fs'):
 try: (p/name/'denied').write_text('x'); r[name+'_errno']=0
 except OSError as e: r[name+'_errno']=e.errno
try: (p/'src'/'still-writable').write_text('ok'); r['src_writable']=True
except OSError as e: r['src_writable']=False; r['src_errno']=e.errno
r['mountinfo']=pathlib.Path('/proc/self/mountinfo').read_text()
r['findmnt']={}
for name in ('rw','ro','fs'):
 x=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/findmnt','-n','-o','OPTIONS','--mountpoint',str(p/name)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=5)
 lines=x.stdout.splitlines(); opts=sorted(set(lines[0].strip().split(','))) if x.returncode==0 and len(lines)==1 and lines[0].strip() else None
 r['findmnt'][name]={'status':x.returncode,'out':x.stdout,'err':x.stderr,'options':opts,'native_options':native['findmnt'][name]['options'],'options_match':opts==native['findmnt'][name]['options'] if opts is not None else False}
r['matches']=(r.get('rw_source')=='via-rw\n' and r.get('ro_errno')==errno.EROFS and r.get('fs_errno')==errno.EROFS and r.get('src_writable') and all(r['findmnt'][x]['status']==0 and r['findmnt'][x]['options_match'] for x in ('rw','ro','fs')))
(H/'mount-observation.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
print('mount-effects='+('verified' if r['matches'] else 'mismatch'))
